author: XERD
what_it_is: All characters unlocked, all missions completed, a three-star nickname and a Yoshi emblem.

gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.dst) Game Save (North America)

format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header (game 'Mario Kart DS', name 'mariokartds'), then 106240 bytes of block-RLE-compressed save (32 blocks decoding to 256 KiB: the 256 KiB flash)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-ards.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 262144 --stem 'Mario Kart DS (USA, Australia) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)' --out DIR: drops the Action Replay header; fits it to the 262144-byte chip (exact size) and writes each core's file
